desc:
🌲 Find The 99 Nights in the Forest! 🌲
This is a fanmade game inspired by 99 Nights in the Forest!
Your mission is simple: search and find hidden objects through the desert, snow and forest biomes from the original game. 🔎✨

Stay alert — not everything is easy to find, and every match is a new adventure. Can you collect everything? 🌌

Credits to the original creators of 99 Nights in the Forest.
This Roblox experience is not official, it is a fanmade project.
